observations: The page number «5» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L03 end chapter 3 (p. 4, JP2 0036). L04: the chapter heading, in bold, centred. L15: the vertical bar between «feria» and «et» marks the beginning of fol. 42 recto of C, which the note in the right margin, «C 42r», names; transcribed as a margin note.

L06: the i of «invenitur» is a sort that stands raised above the base line, its foot at the height of the middle of the n; transcribed «invenitur». L09: the e of «quodque» is lightly printed, with a stain beside it.

L27-L28: the epoch of the example, 26 January 1126, a Tuesday (feria tertia), the first day of al-Muharram of the Arab year 520; the sentence stands only in O (note 48). Checked: in the arithmetical calendar of the Hijra 1 Muharram 520 falls on 27 January 1126 (Julian), a Wednesday, counted from the civil epoch (16 July 622), and on 26 January, a Tuesday, counted from the astronomical epoch (15 July 622), one day earlier, which the text follows.
N04: «O. —{sup:13})», the dash set close to the note number. The colon of L06 and the semicolon of L07 stand after the thin space of the edition (14 and 11 px measured).

critical_notes.evidence: the note numbers of the line run 37, 38, 39, 40, and the apparatus has note 38 on «notula» (N12, «38) notula] nota O.»); the number after «notula» is printed 33, which is already the note on «coacervato» in L18
critical_notes.impact: the variant of O belongs to note 38
